info.title: Aviary API Documentation
info.description: This is the documentation for the Aviary RESTful API. This documents the endpoints that are used by the Aviary backend server to retrieve and update data about collections, resources, media files, indexes, transcripts, and supplemental files, in addition to adding new records into the application.

post.description: This endpoint allows Aviary users to sign in with an API Key and, upon successful authentication, returns a JSON response containing data about the user's profile and data about each of the organizations that the user is a member of. For more information about generating an Aviary user API Key, see: [Creating an API Key](https://coda.aviaryplatform.com/edit-user-profile-83#_luHGN).

put.description: Use PUT request to update an existing resource. New metadata values are merged into a field's existing values rather than replacing them outright (repeatable fields will accumulate additional values on each PUT). To clear all existing values from a metadata field instead of adding to them, send a single value of the literal string `[TRUNCATE]` for that field; the API will delete the field's existing metadata rather than appending. Sending an empty string or omitting the field entirely will NOT clear it — the field's current value(s) are left untouched in that case.

access.description: Resource access status. Accepted values: public, private, restricted, internal.

custom_unique_identifier.description: Changes the resource's custom unique identifier. Must be unique within the organization; a duplicate value returns an error and no changes are applied.

metadata.description: Keyed by the resource's metadata field label (the object shown here uses "location" as an example, but any of the resource's existing custom or default field labels may be used as a key). For each field: sending one or more values ADDS to the field's existing values rather than replacing them. To CLEAR a field's existing value(s) entirely, send a single entry with a value of the literal string `[TRUNCATE]`; the API deletes the field's metadata rather than merging it. An empty string or a missing field is a no-op and leaves current values unchanged — it will not clear the field.

Example 1.title: Black in Design 2021: "Black Matter," Panel Discussion 4: Black in Design Mentorship Initiative

Example 2 - Clear a metadata field.summary: Use [TRUNCATE] to remove all existing values from a field
Example 2 - Clear a metadata field.description: Sending this body deletes all existing values from the "Participants" field on the resource rather than adding to them. Any other field labels omitted from the request are left unchanged.

post.summary: Upload a new media file for a resource
post.description:
The Aviary API does not allow media files larger than 100 MB to be directly uploaded. Instead, users must break media files into 100 MB chunks and send each piece describing it and the content range in the POST to the chunked media file upload endpoint (a slightly different workflow from single file upload).

##### Here we have a example:

```
import requests
import os
import uuid
from uuid import uuid4
CHUNK_SIZE = 1000000

def read_in_chunks(file_object, CHUNK_SIZE):
    while True:
        data = file_object.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
        if not data:
            break
        yield data


def upload(file, url):
  content_name = str(file)
  content_path = os.path.abspath(file)
  content_size = os.stat(content_path).st_size


print(content_name, content_path, content_size)


f = open(content_path, “rb”)


index = 0
  offset = 0
  headers = {}


for chunk in read_in_chunks(f, CHUNK_SIZE):
    offset = index + len(chunk)
    headers[‘Content-Range’] = ‘bytes %s-%s/%s’ % (index, offset -1, content_size)
    headers[‘access-token’] = ‘ErutfY1xgh2aLfT8OG-qcA’
    headers[‘client’] = ‘T1JsOijMdkKMPlIjf-fGmQ’
    headers[‘uid’] = ‘user@example.com’
    headers[‘organization-id’] = ‘5’
    index = offset
    try:
        params = {“collection_resource_id”: “90”,“access”: “true”,“filename”: “sample.mp4”,“is_360”: “false”, “title”: str(uuid4())}
        files = {“media_file”: chunk}
        r = requests.post(url=url, files=files,params=params, headers=headers)
        print(r.json())
        print(“r: %s, Content-Range: %s” % (r, headers[‘Content-Range’]))
    except Exception as e:
        print(e)
upload(‘Video1.mp4’, “https://aviaryplatform.com/api/v1/media_files”)
```

filename.description: The stored media filename. When updated, the file is also renamed on S3 storage.

post.summary: Upload a new media file for a resource

multipart.description: Optional, only with media_file=presigned. When true, a Wasabi multipart (chunked) upload is started and the response contains multipart_upload (upload_id, part_size, parts_count, expires_in and parts with part_number and url) instead of presigned_url. PUT each chunk of the file (part_size bytes, the last one can be smaller) to its part url, in any order, then call the complete endpoint with the upload_id.

file_size.description: Required when multipart=true. Total file size in bytes (max 25GB).

part_size.description: Optional when multipart=true. Chunk size in bytes, between 5MB and 5GB. Default 100MB.

get.description: Update the status of media file as complete after successfully uploading to wasabi presigned url.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Required only for multipart uploads: the multipart_upload.upload_id returned when the media file was created. The uploaded parts are collected from Wasabi and joined into the final file before processing starts.

parameters.name: parts_count
parameters.description: Optional for multipart uploads: the multipart_upload.parts_count returned when the media file was created. When given, completion fails if fewer parts were uploaded.

post.description: Creates a pending Gentle alignment request for a media file, mirroring the 'Align existing transcript' option in the Web UI. The request is added to the organization's pending automated metadata queue and does not auto-approve or begin processing. Supply exactly one of `transcript_id` (an existing transcript already attached to the media file) or `transcript_file` (a new TXT transcript to attach and align).

media_file_id.description: Id of an existing media file to align against.

transcript_id.description: Id of an existing transcript attached to the media file, to be aligned. Mutually exclusive with transcript_file; exactly one is required.

transcript_file.description: A new TXT transcript to attach to the media file and align. Mutually exclusive with transcript_id; exactly one is required. Only text/plain uploads are accepted.

remove_existing_timecode.description: Whether legacy timecode in the transcript should be stripped before alignment.

put.description: Replace the existing transcript file and/or update transcript metadata. Include `associated_file` to replace the transcript file. All request body fields are optional.

associated_file.description: Upload a new transcript file to replace the existing transcript

post.summary: Add or Invite an Org User: /api/v1/organization_users
post.description: Allows an organization owner or admin to add an existing Aviary user to their organization or invite a new user by email. If the user does not yet have an Aviary account, an invitation email is sent to the provided address. If the user exists but is not yet a member of the organization, they are added with a pending status and receive a confirmation email. Role to assign to the user within the organization are organization_owner, organization_admin, organization_user, assigned_user.

post.summary: Create Aviary Resource & Upload Media from an OHMS Studio record: /api/v1/ohms/records/{id}/create_aviary_resource
post.description:
Does through the API what the "Create Aviary Resource & Upload Media" action does in the OHMS Studio interface. The OHMS Studio record must have embedded media and must not be synced to an Aviary resource yet.

The request is validated and queued; it returns `202 Accepted` with a job. In the background, the job creates the Aviary resource in the given collection with the record's metadata, imports the media (local files, YouTube, Vimeo and other supported hosts), carries over the OHMS indexes and transcripts, updates the OHMS Studio record with the Aviary media host, URL and embed data, and marks the record and the new resource as synced. When the job succeeds, `resource_id` holds the new Aviary resource ID. When it fails, `error` explains why.

The resource is always created in the OHMS Studio record's own organization.

collection_id.description: Destination Aviary collection. Must belong to the organization.

title.description: Display title of the new Aviary resource.

is_featured.description: Featured status of the new Aviary resource: true or false.

access.description: Access of the new Aviary resource, with the same values as the Resources endpoints.

404.description: 404 response - OHMS Studio record or collection not found in the organization

409.description: 409 response - the OHMS Studio record is already synced, or a sync is in progress

422.description: 422 response - invalid parameters, no embedded media, or resource limit reached

post.summary: Resync OHMS Studio record → Aviary resource: /api/v1/ohms/records/{id}/resync_to_aviary
post.description:
Updates the Aviary resource the OHMS Studio record is synced to from the record, the same way the OHMS → Aviary sync button of the OHMS Studio interface does: metadata, indexes and transcripts are updated in place and the resource is not deleted and recreated.

The target Aviary resource comes from the existing sync link (created in the interface, by the create_aviary_resource endpoint or by the link endpoint). Pass `resource_id` as a safety check: the request is rejected when it is not the linked resource.

Runs as a background job; returns `202 Accepted` with a job.

resource_id.description: Optional. Expected linked Aviary resource ID.

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - OHMS Studio record not found in the organization

409.description: 409 response - resource_id does not match the link, or a sync is in progress

422.description: 422 response - the OHMS Studio record is not synced to an Aviary resource

post.summary: Resync Aviary resource → OHMS Studio record: /api/v1/ohms/resources/{id}/resync_to_ohms
post.description:
Updates the OHMS Studio record the Aviary resource is synced to from the resource, the same way the Aviary → OHMS re-sync button does, including the transcript. Edits made to that transcript in OHMS Studio since the last sync are overwritten.

The target OHMS Studio record comes from the existing sync link. Pass `ohms_record_id` as a safety check: the request is rejected when it is not the linked record.

Runs as a background job; returns `202 Accepted` with a job. A succeeded job reports `result.transcript_updated`.

ohms_record_id.description: Optional. Expected linked OHMS Studio record ID.

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - Aviary resource not found, or its linked OHMS Studio record was deleted

409.description: 409 response - ohms_record_id does not match the link, or a sync is in progress

422.description: 422 response - the Aviary resource is not synced to an OHMS Studio record

post.summary: Link an existing OHMS Studio record and Aviary resource as synced: /api/v1/ohms/records/{id}/link
post.description:
Marks an existing OHMS Studio record and an existing Aviary resource of the same organization as synced, with the same link the interface and the create_aviary_resource endpoint create. Afterwards the sync buttons and both resync endpoints work on the pair.

Only the link is written: the content of neither record changes. Run a resync endpoint afterwards to push changes in the direction you choose.

The request is rejected when the OHMS Studio record is already linked to another Aviary resource, or the Aviary resource to another OHMS Studio record, unless `replace_existing` is true; the previous links are then removed. This endpoint responds immediately and does not create a job.

resource_id.description: Existing Aviary resource of the organization.

replace_existing.description: Optional. Replace an existing link of either record instead of rejecting the request.

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - OHMS Studio record or Aviary resource not found in the organization

409.description: 409 response - conflicting existing link, or a sync is in progress

post.summary: Regenerate an OHMS Studio record's VTT transcript from the transcript view: /api/v1/ohms/records/{id}/regenerate_vtt
post.description:
Rebuilds the stored VTT transcript (`<vtt_transcript>`, and `<vtt_transcript_alt>` when present) of the OHMS Studio record from the transcript segments shown in the OHMS transcript view: cue text, timecodes, speaker names, footnotes and line breaks. The transcript view is the source of truth, so Export Transcript to VTT and Export OHMS XML match what users see.

The previous VTT file is backed up before it is overwritten. Transcripts whose stored VTT already matches are left unchanged. With `dry_run`, the job only reports which transcripts differ, without writing.

If the record is synced to an Aviary resource, the change is not pushed automatically; call the resync_to_aviary endpoint afterwards.

Runs as a background job; returns `202 Accepted` with a job. A succeeded job reports each transcript in `result.transcripts`.

dry_run.description: Optional. Only report whether the stored VTT differs from the transcript view.

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - OHMS Studio record not found in the organization

409.description: 409 response - a sync or job is already in progress for the OHMS Studio record

422.description: 422 response - no VTT transcript or no transcript segment data

post.summary: Convert a legacy OHMS transcript to OHMS Aviary VTT: /api/v1/ohms/records/{id}/convert_legacy_transcript
post.description:
Converts the OHMS Studio record's legacy `<transcript>`/`<sync>` transcript to an OHMS Aviary VTT transcript (`<vtt_transcript>`) with the same conversion as the "Convert a Legacy OHMS Transcript" action of the OHMS Studio interface. Speaker names, footnotes and line breaks are preserved, and the converted transcript can be edited in the transcript editor and displayed in the OHMS Viewer. As in the interface, the legacy transcript is kept so the conversion can be reverted.

By default the alternate transcript (`<transcript_alt>`/`<sync_alt>`) is converted too when the record has one.

Runs as a background job; returns `202 Accepted` with a job. A succeeded job lists the converted transcripts in `result.converted_transcripts`.

double_line_breaks.description: Optional. Use when the transcript contains double line breaks on every row. This pulls together paragraphs organized by speaker names, eliminating extraneous line breaks (the checkbox of the interface).

alt_transcript.description: Optional. true also converts the alternate transcript and rejects the request when there is none; false converts only the main transcript. When omitted, the alternate transcript is converted when present.

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - OHMS Studio record not found in the organization

409.description: 409 response - a sync or job is already in progress for the OHMS Studio record

422.description: 422 response - no legacy transcript, already converted, or no alternate transcript

get.description:
Returns the status of a job queued by an OHMS Studio API endpoint: `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`.

* `resource_id`: the Aviary resource the job works on. For create_aviary_resource, the new resource once the job has succeeded.
* `error`: why a failed job failed.
* `result`: details of a succeeded resync_to_ohms, regenerate_vtt or convert_legacy_transcript job.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job ID returned by an OHMS Studio API endpoint

403.description: 403 response - IP address not allowlisted for the organization, or not an Org Admin/Owner

404.description: 404 response - job not found in the organization
